軍事基地

A high-risk site with armed guards, anti-air defenses and radar airdrops.

遊び方

The newer route activates three indoor computers for a keycard; official support also records a chance to loot one from guards.

主な報酬

Use the card at the radar roof to call multiple airdrops. The card is consumed and the radar enters cooldown.

危険

Guards throw grenades and attack in groups; nearby players are notified when drops arrive.

Recycler

For recycling, visit a gas station, parking lot, town, warehouse, Lumberjack or Miner.
